+// Custom UnmarshalJSON for CaddyHeaders to handle case-insensitive header names
+func (h *CaddyHeaders) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
+	// First unmarshal into a map
+	var raw map[string]interface{}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	// Initialize slices
+	h.UserAgent = []string{}
+	h.Referer = []string{}
+	h.ContentType = []string{}
+	h.XForwardedFor = []string{}
+	h.AcceptLanguage = []string{}
+
+	// Handle referer/referrer with precedence
+	refererCandidates := make(map[string][]string)
+	
+	// Process each key case-insensitively
+	for key, value := range raw {
+		// Convert value to []string if possible
+		var stringSlice []string
+		switch v := value.(type) {
+		case []interface{}:
+			for _, item := range v {
+				if str, ok := item.(string); ok {
+					stringSlice = append(stringSlice, str)
+				}
+			}
+		case string:
+			stringSlice = []string{v}
+		default:
+			// Skip unrecognized types
+			continue
+		}
+
+		// Match headers case-insensitively
+		lowerKey := strings.ToLower(key)
+		switch lowerKey {
+		case "user-agent":
+			h.UserAgent = stringSlice
+		case "referer", "referrer":
+			refererCandidates[key] = stringSlice
+		case "content-type":
+			h.ContentType = stringSlice
+		case "x-forwarded-for":
+			h.XForwardedFor = stringSlice
+		case "accept-language":
+			h.AcceptLanguage = stringSlice
+		}
+	}
+	
+	// Apply referer with precedence: "Referer" > "Referrer" > "referer" > "referrer"
+	precedenceOrder := []string{"Referer", "Referrer", "referer", "referrer"}
+	for _, key := range precedenceOrder {
+		if val, exists := refererCandidates[key]; exists {
+			h.Referer = val
+			break
+		}
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}
